acs_postsecondary_percent_geo20.long_description: Postsecondary educational attainment measures the share of residents who have completed any education beyond high school. Higher attainment rates correlate with greater economic mobility, higher household incomes, and better health outcomes. This indicator helps identify communities that may benefit from expanded access to higher education and workforce development programs.
acs_postsecondary_percent_geo20.long_name: Estimated Percentage of the Population With Any Postsecondary Education
acs_postsecondary_percent_geo20.provenance: Computed from ACS 5-year estimates, table B06009 (Place of Birth by Educational Attainment). Postsecondary education includes anyone reporting education at the associate degree level or higher.
acs_postsecondary_percent_geo20.short_description: Percentage of the population with any postsecondary education.

sources.name: U.S. Census, American Community Survey
sources.location: 5-Year estimates, table B06009, via the API

acs_postsecondary_percent_geo20.statement: {value} of those in {region_name} report any postsecondary education.

acs_postsecondary_count_geo20.long_description: The count of residents who have completed any education beyond high school. This raw count complements the percentage measure by capturing the absolute size of the educated workforce in a community, which is relevant for economic development planning and institutional capacity.
acs_postsecondary_count_geo20.long_name: Estimated Number of People With Any Postsecondary Education
acs_postsecondary_count_geo20.provenance: Directly tabulated from ACS 5-year estimates, table B06009 (Place of Birth by Educational Attainment). Postsecondary education includes anyone reporting education at the associate degree level or higher.
acs_postsecondary_count_geo20.short_description: Number of residents with any postsecondary education.

sources.name: U.S. Census, American Community Survey
